mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dd_case_subject(case_subject_id, case_id, party_id, subject_role, primary_slot, source_profile_id, source_relation_id, ownership_percentage, ubo_basis, job_title, required_flag, create_time) VALUES(#{row.caseSubjectId}, #{row.caseId}, #{row.partyId}, #{row.subjectRole}, #{row.primarySlot}, #{row.sourceProfileId}, #{row.sourceRelationId}, #{row.ownershipPercentage}, #{row.uboBasis}, #{row.jobTitle}, #{row.requiredFlag}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT case_subject_id AS caseSubjectId, case_id AS caseId, party_id AS partyId, subject_role AS subjectRole, primary_slot AS primarySlot, source_profile_id AS sourceProfileId, source_relation_id AS sourceRelationId, ownership_percentage AS ownershipPercentage, ubo_basis AS uboBasis, job_title AS jobTitle, required_flag AS requiredFlag, create_time AS createTime FROM t_dd_case_subject WHERE case_id IN #{id} ORDER BY case_id, case_subject_id
